comparison.objective: Orient a calibration board toward a camera and stand it in a holder; candidate finishes installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Large rigid-board grasping, orientation, and holder insertion versus narrow-tool coaxial alignment, two-arm hammer use, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Board stably seated facing the camera versus four tangs fractured and contained with no insert or shell damage. Exact holder tolerances are absent from the record.
comparison.reason: Fixture placement and visual orientation do not exercise impact fracture, lateral-force limits on a retained coil, or debris accounting.
